scope: Actual AudioEngine methods with controlled graph nodes and AudioParam exponential-target semantics. No browser PCM, scheduling, physical sockets, native build or Serato parity acceptance. EQ-ramp regression is a controlled construction boundary, requiring actual PCM confirmation.

checks.name: Stem inputs tee once to cue before selected cross routes
EQ changes after strip creation mirror targets to cue
Channel Filter switches rewire both strips without duplicate high edges
Track replacement disconnects old tees and preserves a single cue strip
Global silence clears exit effects and restores both channel strips
Creating cue strip during an active EQ ramp must retain the EQ target
